full_name: Katharine Park | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Katharine Park is the Samuel Zemurray, Jr., and Doris Zemurray Stone Radcliffe Professor of the History of Science and Women’s Studies at Harvard University, where she teaches courses on the history of early European science and medicine and on the history of women, gender, and the body.
